verdict.rationale: Pricing transparency about seat minimums and billing commitments is a fair question for a SaaS work-management product, so the axis applies. The only pricing-related evidence covers the Free plan ('No credit card needed', 'Unlimited time on Free plan'). It says nothing about whether paid plans enforce a minimum seat count or an annual billing commitment, so it is adjacent at best and earns no credit.

support.subject: As a product manager, I know whether my plan enforces a minimum seat count or annual billing commitment before I subscribe
